title: Evaluation at 5 and 10 Years of Renal Transplant Patients
official: Evaluation at 5 and 10 Years of Renal Transplant Patients Who Received a Graft Preserved in a Solution HEMO2life®
summary: 5 and 10 years follow-up of the oxyop study.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* informed patients participating to the oxyop study
* Patient having completed the OXYOP M12 follow-up visit
* Patient agreeing to participate in the observational study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Opposition to the use his medical data
* patient deceased or with graft lost before M48
